_about: Paper Cinema effects catalogue (Lantern Origami). Each effect: what it looks like, when to use it, duration in frames at 24 fps, parameters with defaults, which renderer can do it, and status: built (in code and used), new (added with engine/fx.js), planned. Guide: docs/EFFECTS-CATALOG.md. Technique only; we copy no frames or assets. House rules: amber = human, crimson = demonic, paint and paper shards instead of blood.

effects.name: Bloom
effects.looks: Bright parts (eye slits, emissive seams, sparks, the blade edge) bleed a soft halo of light into the dark around them.
effects.use: Always on, low (0.3–0.6) as the house lantern glow; raise to 1+ on a power-up or a decisive flare.

effects.name: Bloom pulse
effects.looks: The whole frame glows brighter for a moment, then settles.
effects.use: Impact, the "decide" eye flare, a demonic surge.

effects.name: Colour grade (mood LUT)
effects.looks: Lift/gamma/gain per channel, contrast, saturation; named moods: dawn, lantern, moonlit, demonic, kurosawa, ash.
effects.use: Sets the emotion of a scene: lantern = warm human resolve, moonlit = cold dread, demonic = crimson menace, ash = aftermath, kurosawa = memory/flashback.
effects.where: engine/fx.js MOODS + fxAt "grade"; ffmpeg: lut3d / colorbalance

effects.name: Kurosawa black and white
effects.looks: High-contrast monochrome with heavy grain, wind pushed up.
effects.use: Flashback, legend, a duel told as history.

effects.name: Vignette
effects.looks: Corners and edges sink toward near-black (cos⁴-like falloff), drawing the eye to the centre.
effects.use: Moody close-ups, monologue, the 70%-darkness reference look.

effects.name: Film grain
effects.looks: Fine per-frame noise, strongest in mid-tones, highlights protected.
effects.use: Every moody shot (0.04–0.07); heavier for flashback/black-and-white (0.09+). Hides banding in dark gradients.

effects.name: Letterbox strip
effects.looks: Black bars slide in top and bottom, leaving a cinematic strip inside the 9:16 frame (title text can sit above).
effects.use: Prestige moments: the monologue, the standoff, the hook. Slide in on a beat, never mid-action.

effects.name: Chromatic aberration flash
effects.looks: RGB channels split radially for a few frames: red pushed out, blue in; strongest at the edges.
effects.use: Impacts, clashes, a hit that rattles the lens. Never as a permanent look.

effects.name: White-amber flash
effects.looks: The frame washes to warm white for 1–2 frames.
effects.use: Blade contact, a lightning cut, the moment before an impact frame.

effects.name: Fade to black
effects.looks: Frame fades to a colour (black by default).
effects.use: Ending, cut to logo, time skip.

effects.name: Ink impact frame
effects.looks: The picture becomes flat sumi ink on washi: darks to ink, lights to paper; the hottest glow (eyes) stays amber/crimson. invert:1 gives a negative frame.
effects.use: The decisive hit only (once or twice per film), on the contact frame.
effects.where: engine/fx.js fxAt "ink-impact" (post, any page); engine/motion.js has a geometry version (fighters only)

effects.name: Speed lines (focus lines)
effects.looks: Tapered ink wedges radiate from a clear centre, redrawn on twos so they flicker.
effects.use: Dash, lunge, a sudden realisation; aim the centre at the target. Ink-dark on light sets, washi-pale on dark ones.

effects.name: Trauma screen shake
effects.looks: Camera jitters with smooth noise; offset ∝ trauma², with a small roll; decays.
effects.use: Heavy impacts, stomps, a body hitting the ground. Shake on ones even when bodies move on twos.
effects.where: engine/fx.js shake() + traumaAt(); engine/motion.js has its own impact punch

effects.name: Impact punch (fov kick)
effects.looks: FOV snaps tighter on the hit and springs back; roll wobble.
effects.use: Every clash, scaled by intensity.

effects.name: Hit-stop
effects.looks: Fighters freeze for a few frames at contact (with a ±6 mm shiver) while camera, sparks and sound keep running.
effects.use: Every blade contact; longer for heavier hits.

effects.name: Smear ribbon
effects.looks: A tapering white (or red on the impact frame) paper strip swept behind the blade tip.
effects.use: Any fast swing above 5 m/s tip speed.

effects.name: Paper-shard sparks
effects.looks: White-gold paper shards burst from the contact point and fall.
effects.use: Blade-to-blade contact; count scales with intensity.

effects.name: Light shafts (god-ray cards)
effects.looks: Soft additive beams from one high light, flickering slightly; each card turns to face the camera around its axis.
effects.use: The lone-hero reference look: dark hall, one shaft, sword raised into it. Revelation, prayer, entrance.

effects.name: Screen-space god rays
effects.looks: Radial blur of the bright sky/sun behind occluders, so the figure cuts dark streaks out of the light.
effects.use: Backlit dawn silhouettes.
effects.where: planned: second ShaderPass with an occlusion pre-pass (GPU Gems 3 ch. 13)

effects.name: Volumetric fog
effects.looks: Depth haze plus light that scatters in the air; shafts become visible.
effects.use: Openings, establishing shots, the 70%-dark hall.
effects.where: Blender: Volume Scatter in the world/hall (blender/world/build_world.py --fog); three.js uses scene.fog + light-shafts

effects.name: Dust motes
effects.looks: Tiny warm specks drifting and twinkling in the light.
effects.use: Quiet before the storm, interiors, a held stare. Needs a dark surround and a hard beam.

effects.name: Embers
effects.looks: Glowing orange/crimson sparks rising and flickering.
effects.use: Demonic presence, a burning set, rage building; crimson for demons.

effects.name: Falling petals
effects.looks: Pale paper petals tumbling down on the wind.
effects.use: Farewell, a death, spring duels, a calm before the strike.

effects.name: Snow
effects.looks: Soft white flakes falling.
effects.use: Winter duels, isolation, silence.

effects.name: Ash
effects.looks: Grey flakes drifting down slowly.
effects.use: Aftermath, a burned village, black-and-white memory.

effects.name: Paper shards
effects.looks: Small paper triangles falling and turning (house rule: shards, not blood).
effects.use: After a cut lands on a paper body; a torn banner.

effects.name: Rain
effects.looks: Thin bright streaks, slanted by wind, with splashes on the ground.
effects.use: Grief, a duel in a storm, heavy mood.
effects.where: planned: LineSegments streaks in fx.js; Blender particle system

effects.name: Sword glint "ping"
effects.looks: A 4-ray star with a thin diagonal pair pops on the blade edge, peaks, rotates a little and dies.
effects.use: 4–6 frames before a strike (warning), on a draw, a hero beauty shot. Pair with a high "ping" sound.

effects.name: Lens flare
effects.looks: A chain of soft ghosts and a streak across the frame from a bright source.
effects.use: Sunrise reveal, an Akira-style headlight moment; sparingly.
effects.where: planned: three/addons Lensflare (MIT) on the sun disc

effects.name: Eye glow trail
effects.looks: The glowing eye slits leave a short bright streak when the head whips.
effects.use: Head snap, a demon turning, the "decide" moment.
effects.where: planned: ribbon (like the smear ribbon) from the eye joints; bloom carries it

effects.name: Aura
effects.looks: A boiling halo of light leaking from the paper seams, with rising sparks; edges boil at 8–12 fps.
effects.use: Power-up, demonic possession, will to fight. Crimson = demonic, amber = human.
effects.where: planned: inflated back-face shell + noise + bloom, plus ember particles

effects.name: Afterimages
effects.looks: 2–4 fading paper copies trail a fast swing or dash.
effects.use: Superhuman speed, a feint.
effects.where: planned: re-pose the figure at earlier body times (motion.js does this for the ribbon) with fading ghost materials; not AfterimagePass (feedback is not frame-independent)

effects.name: Flash-step
effects.looks: The fighter folds flat, bursts into confetti, a light streak crosses the screen, he unfolds behind the target; the camera whips with it.
effects.use: Teleport-fast dash, a reversal.

effects.name: Shadow vanish
effects.looks: The shadow slides away first, then the body dissolves into ink.
effects.use: Ninja/demon exit, an ambush set-up.

effects.name: Ink splash transition
effects.looks: A sumi-ink splash or brush stroke spreads across the frame as a matte, revealing the next shot.
effects.use: Scene changes, chapter cards, the title.
effects.where: planned: high-contrast ink matte (SHIMI can generate one) → ffmpeg maskedmerge between shots

effects.name: Speed ramp
effects.looks: Time slows into the moment of importance, then snaps back faster (1 → 0.25 → 1.15).
effects.use: The approach to the decisive blow; a dodge seen in slow motion.
effects.where: planned: a body-time warp track like hit-stop in motion.js

effects.name: Slow motion hold
effects.looks: Bodies at quarter speed while particles and camera keep a little faster.
effects.use: Grief, the moment after the cut, zanshin.

effects.name: Depth of field / rack focus
effects.looks: Shallow focus isolates a subject; a rack pulls focus from hand to eyes or to the opponent.
effects.use: Intimacy, realisation, linking two subjects without a cut.
effects.where: planned: three/addons BokehPass (MIT) inserted before bloom

effects.name: Motion blur
effects.looks: Directional blur on fast camera whips and swings.
effects.use: Whip-pan cuts; never on the slash frame itself (the smear does that job).
effects.where: Blender motion blur; ffmpeg tmix on whip pans

effects.name: Whip-pan cut
effects.looks: The camera swings fast with heavy blur and cuts at the blurriest frame.
effects.use: Change of fighter, match-cut eye → sun.

effects.name: Dutch tilt
effects.looks: Camera rolled 12–18°.
effects.use: Unease, a bind, a demon's point of view.

effects.name: Stepped timing (on twos)
effects.looks: Bodies update every second frame; camera and effects stay on ones.
effects.use: Gives the 3D preview the anime cadence; ones for the decisive cut.
effects.where: planned: quantise body time in the page; fx.js already redraws speed lines on twos
